# Casefile v0.11.0

## Codex role selection

Casefile keeps its named agents and their instructions. When you choose a delegated strategy, it
shows the model class suggested for each role and recommends a concrete model and reasoning effort
from the available launch options. Accept the set or edit individual roles before delegation.
Casefile records the confirmed choices with the strategy and checks their availability on resume.
Solo strategies require no assignments.

## Upgrade from 0.10.0

Install the 0.11.0 Casefile plugin, then invoke `$casefile:casefile-update` with your existing
planning root. Review the preview, apply the update, and start a new Codex session.

The update retires the Casefile-managed model catalog and generated model-specific writer roles. It
uses the installation receipt to recover displaced settings and preserves catalogs referenced by
host configuration or custom agents. Hosts using provider discovery keep that setting. An eligible
writer choice previously confirmed by a human can be reused. Other delegated roles require an
explicit selection.
